buildDurationSols.assumptionNote: Allow at least two sols for habitat assembly.

solRules: Available solar energy and bounded battery discharge serve housing first, then the selected priority order.
Recycled water is available immediately. Newly collected wastewater is available next sol.
Construction advances one habitat at a time. A completed habitat operates next sol.
One crop batch is planted at the start. Growth advances by the supplied fraction when the minimum fraction is met. Harvest enters storage after crew meals.
All food quantities use edible mass. Electrical balances cover the entire sol.
